# HiGHS for the browser (highs-js 1.15.4)

Files copied unchanged from the npm package `highs` 1.15.4 (https://github.com/lovasoa/highs-js), MIT
licence (see LICENSE). HiGHS itself (https://highs.dev, University of Edinburgh) is MIT-licensed too.

The Market planner uses it in a Web Worker (`js/market-worker.js`) to prove its plans optimal. The files
are self-hosted, so visitors' browsers never contact a third-party CDN.
